appearance_facts.fact: The chart is titled 'Hydroelectricity vs Nuclear energy'.
The right y-axis is labeled 'Nuclear energy (%)'.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 2000 to 2050.
A solid blue line with circular markers represents Hydroelectricity, plotted against the left y-axis.
A dashed red line with square markers represents Nuclear energy, plotted against the right y-axis.
At the 2010 mark on the x-axis, the blue line (Hydroelectricity) is at 35%, and the red line (Nuclear energy) is at 23%.
At the 2050 mark on the x-axis, the blue line (Hydroelectricity) is higher than the red line (Nuclear energy).
